description: docs/plans/cognitive-core-phase-2-contract-2026-07-22.md §4 (G-F4 producer-identity invariant). producer_key MUST be a source/component identity drawn from the adapter-declared producer set — an officer identity is structurally invalid (the never-a-score latch). Within the closed registry subset the enum IS the mechanical latch: an officer slug is not a member, so it fails validation. Later COG-2 units extend the enum as adapters land (consequence, envelope-file).

table_version.description: Version of the versioned trust table this confidence was derived under (epoch input)

producer_key.description: Component/source identity — the adapter-declared producer set only, never an officer identity. UNIT 2 adds the envelope-file adapter's declared producers (§5.2a); UNIT 3 adds the consequence-ledger adapter's producer (framework/fidelity/consequence, §5.4). A module-path source identity is not an officer identity (the G-F4 never-a-score latch holds).
